name: line_category

state.task: Judge the OCR text of `line`, one line recognised from a scanned page of an archaeological report or related material from a Czech archive (1920–2020). `before` and `after` are its neighbours on the page.

source: categories and definitions: atrium_vocab.CONCEPTS['line-category']; asked on S1–S5 lines

criteria.Clear: Structurally sound text with low perplexity.
criteria.Noisy: Partially degraded text (e.g., isolated strange symbols, mid-word uppercase).
criteria.Trash: Severe OCR corruption, high symbol density, gibberish, or failed language ID.
criteria.Non-text: Lines that are too short, lack letters, or are purely numbers/symbols.
